IC1: - Electively scheduled for surgical operation that require general anesthesia [AND] and expected duration of hospitalization of longer than one day (for patients in Perioperative Evaluation & Management [POEM]) [OR] or high clinical suspicion of sepsis by the emergency physician (for patients in emergency center)
IC2: - Ability to give informed consent. If the patient is incapacitated and unable to give informed consent, the next-of-kin or a person who has the power of attorney must be present for informed consent.
IC3: - For patients in the emergency center only, two or more of the following SIRS criteria:
IC4: - Leukocytes > 12,000/mm^3 [OR] or < 4,000/mm^3 [OR] or > 10% immature (band) forms, provided that [NOT] no filgrastim [OR] or pegfilgrastim was administered within 30 days [AND] and [NOT] no leukemia
IC6: - Respiratory rate > 20 breaths/min or partial pressure of carbon dioxide (CO2) < 32 mmHg
IC7: - Oral temperature [OR] > 38 degrees Celsius (C) [OR] or < 36 degrees C or axillary temperature > 37 degrees C [OR] or < 35 degrees C
